description: This file implements a configuration class for interacting with RAGFlow vector store datasets. It includes methods for URL construction, environment validation, request transformation for dataset creation, and response parsing, tailored for RAGFlow's API specifications.

classes.name: RAGFlowVectorStoreConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for managing RAGFlow dataset vector stores, providing methods for URL handling, environment validation, and request/response transformations tailored to RAGFlow API.

methods.name: BaseVectorStoreAuthCredentials get_auth_credentials( self, litellm_params: dict )
methods.description: Retrieves authentication credentials, primarily API key, for RAGFlow API, from parameters or environment variable.

methods.name: VectorStoreIndexEndpoints get_vector_store_endpoints_by_type(self)
methods.description: Returns an empty list for read/write endpoints as RAGFlow vector stores are management-only, no search support.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Validates RAGFlow environment by ensuring API key is available and updating headers accordingly.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for RAGFlow datasets API, considering environment variables, parameters, and defaults.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_search_vector_store_request( self, vector_store_id: str, query: Union[str, List[str]], vector_store_search_optional_params: VectorStoreSearchOptionalRequestParams, api_base: str, litellm_logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Raises NotImplementedError as RAGFlow does not support search; datasets are management-only.

methods.name: VectorStoreSearchResponse transform_search_vector_store_response( self, response: httpx.Response, litellm_logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj )
methods.description: Raises NotImplementedError as RAGFlow does not support search; datasets are management-only.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_create_vector_store_request( self, vector_store_create_optional_params: VectorStoreCreateOptionalRequestParams, api_base: str, )
methods.description: Transforms a high-level create request into RAGFlow's API format, including validation and metadata handling.

methods.name: VectorStoreCreateResponse transform_create_vector_store_response( self, response: httpx.Response )
methods.description: Parses RAGFlow create dataset API response, extracting dataset ID, name, and converting timestamps to Unix epoch.

ctags.name: transform_search_vector_store_request
ctags.signature: ( self, vector_store_id: str, query: Union[str, List[str]], vector_store_search_optional_params: VectorStoreSearchOptionalRequestParams, api_base: str, litellm_logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, litellm_params: dict, )
